title: Return policy
content: Personalized products are final sale except for damage or misprints. Standard items can be returned within 30 days if unworn and unwashed.

title: Turnaround time
content: Most restorations take 3 to 5 business days depending on damage. Rush service is available for an extra fee.

title: Embroidery color limit
content: Embroidery designs must use 6 colors or fewer from the approved palette, and avoid thin lines under 1.5mm or gradients.
